Bibliography
============

This section provides references to documentation, standards, and resources used in this project.

Official Documentation
----------------------

MinIO Documentation
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* MinIO Official Documentation: https://docs.min.io/
* MinIO GitHub Repository: https://github.com/minio/minio
* MinIO Docker Images: https://hub.docker.com/r/minio/minio

Docker Resources
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* Docker Documentation: https://docs.docker.com/
* Docker Compose Documentation: https://docs.docker.com/compose/
* Docker Hub: https://hub.docker.com/

SSL/TLS References
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* OpenSSL Documentation: https://www.openssl.org/docs/
* SSL/TLS Best Practices: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8446
* Certificate Authority List: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Certificate_authority

AWS S3 Compatibility
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* Amazon S3 API Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html
* AWS SDK Documentation: https://aws.amazon.com/tools/
* S3 Compatibility Matrix: https://docs.min.io/docs/minio-and-aws-s3-compatibility.html

Programming Languages
---------------------

Python
~~~~~~

* Python Official Documentation: https://docs.python.org/3/
* MinIO Python SDK: https://docs.min.io/docs/python-client-api-reference.html
* Boto3 Documentation: https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/index.html

JavaScript/Node.js
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* Node.js Documentation: https://nodejs.org/en/docs/
* MinIO JavaScript SDK: https://docs.min.io/docs/javascript-client-api-reference.html
* AWS SDK for JavaScript: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-javascript/

Command Line Tools
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* AWS CLI Documentation: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/
* MinIO Client Documentation: https://docs.min.io/docs/minio-client-complete-guide.html

Standards and Protocols
-----------------------

HTTP/HTTPS
~~~~~~~~~~

* HTTP/1.1 Specification: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7230
* HTTPS Specification: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2818
* TLS 1.3 Specification: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8446

REST APIs
~~~~~~~~~

* REST API Design: https://restfulapi.net/
* HTTP Status Codes: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6

Security
--------

* OWASP Security Guidelines: https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/
* SSL/TLS Deployment Best Practices: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7525
* Certificate Best Practices: https://cabforum.org/

DevOps and Infrastructure
-------------------------

* Infrastructure as Code: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infrastructure_as_code
* Container Orchestration: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/
* CI/CD Best Practices: https://cloud.google.com/architecture/devops/devops-tech-overview

Community Resources
-------------------

* MinIO Community Forum: https://forum.min.io/
* Docker Community Forums: https://forums.docker.com/
* Stack Overflow - MinIO: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/minio
* Stack Overflow - Docker: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/docker

Books and Articles
------------------

Recommended Reading
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* "Designing Data-Intensive Applications" by Martin Kleppmann
* "Infrastructure as Code" by Kief Morris
* "The Docker Book" by James Turnbull
* "Web Scalability for Startup Engineers" by Artur Ejsmont

Research Papers
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

* MinIO Architecture Paper: https://blog.min.io/minio-architecture/
